messages.label: 1. /llm-bus coordinate P
messages.note: Typed in the coordinator session. The agent finds the objective, Beads workspace and memory ticket, and asks only for missing facts.

messages.label: 2. coordinate P --objective --beads-workspace
messages.note: Bus requires an existing .beads folder, creates project and generation UUIDs, enrolls the coordinator. Optional --delegate gates.

messages.label: 3. /llm-bus join P
messages.note: Your direct request is the consent: this exact session, this coordinator, this objective. Chat or bus messages cannot give it.

messages.label: 4. join P
messages.note: Needs a live session in the project folder. Creates grant and consent, enrolls the worker, records the target and its gate binding.

messages.label: 5. join notice
messages.note: One informational message per grant. It shows the worker was there then; it proves nothing about later reachability.

messages.label: 6. send --project P --direction assign
messages.note: Coordinator saves the bounded task in Beads first. Other directions: reprioritize, clarify, pause, cancel, review.

messages.label: 7. inbox: verified: true
messages.note: Rechecked at inbox, count and wake: generation, coordinator, consent, enrollment, grant. A failure stays in history, hidden from pending.

messages.label: 8. reply: result + evidence
messages.note: Worker acts in its own worktree, saves progress in Beads, replies with --reply-to. Replies and acks carry no authority.

messages.label: 9. coordination claim --ticket --branch
messages.note: One worker per ticket and per branch. Approvals verify only for the claim the worker holds.

messages.label: 10. coordination approve --gate
messages.note: commit, push, merge or merge-admin, only for gates and base branches the owner delegated. Expires in at most 24h.

messages.label: 11. inbox: approve-* verified
messages.note: Project delegation ∩ worker binding must cover gate and base, and the claim must match. Else gate_not_delegated, wrong_ticket, expired.

messages.label: 12. done: commit / push / merge
messages.note: Worker checks branch, head SHA, required CI and review live; the bus checks none. Force-push, deploys, secrets: never delegable.

messages.label: 13. verified result
messages.note: Coordinator checks the evidence before marking the task done. Delivery or acknowledgement proves no completion.

cards.title: Who can direct work
items: Only the current coordinator's verified directions
Message text, tickets, replies and acks never grant authority
Owner instructions and repository rules still win

cards.title: When consent ends
items: Leave, revoke, coordinator replace, session close or 24h idle
A fresh owner join is the only way back
Moving outside the project folder pauses directions, keeps consent

cards.title: Never delegable
items: Credential or secret changes, paid or live runs
Merge with failing or pending CI
